text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can generate art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools help people work faster and try new ideas. However, human creativity and machine creativity are not the same. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI creates by learning from data and patterns. It can copy styles but does not truly understand what it makes. For this reason, many people believe AI is a helpful tool, not a replacement for human artists. The best results often come when people and AI work together, combining human feeling with machine speed.
